article_title: White House blocks Microsoft from foreign worker hiring program

tasks.prompt: What is the central dispute described in the article?
options: The White House has blocked Microsoft and seven other firms from new or pending PERM applications after accusing them of abusing foreign-worker programs, while Microsoft disputes the claims.
Microsoft has decided to stop hiring all US workers and move its headquarters abroad.
US technology firms are asking Congress to abolish every skilled-worker visa.
The government has awarded Microsoft a new contract to process visa applications.
tasks.correct_answer: The White House has blocked Microsoft and seven other firms from new or pending PERM applications after accusing them of abusing foreign-worker programs, while Microsoft disputes the claims.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתארת חסימה ממשלתית של בקשות PERM בעקבות האשמות לניצול התוכניות, מול תגובת Microsoft שמכחישה החלפה או שכר נמוך.

tasks.prompt: What action did the US government announce against Microsoft and the seven other companies?
options: It cancelled all of their existing H1b visas.
It ordered them to rehire every laid-off worker.
It stopped processing their new and pending PERM applications.
It prohibited them from operating outside the US.
tasks.correct_answer: It stopped processing their new and pending PERM applications.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: שר העבודה הודיע שהממשלה לא תטפל בבקשות PERM חדשות או תלויות ועומדות של שמונה החברות.

tasks.prompt: What does “barred” mean in the headline and opening paragraph?
options: Praised publicly
Prevented or officially prohibited
Asked to provide evidence
Paid additional compensation
tasks.explanation_hebrew: barred פירושו נחסם או נאסר באופן רשמי; החברות מנועות כרגע משימוש במסלול המתואר.

tasks.prompt: How did Microsoft respond to the claim that it was replacing US employees with cheaper foreign workers?
options: It said every H1b filing was for a new employee.
It admitted foreign workers receive lower salaries.
It said it had filed no visa applications that year.
It said 80% of its H1b filings involved existing employees and that international hires receive the same compensation as US workers.
tasks.correct_answer: It said 80% of its H1b filings involved existing employees and that international hires receive the same compensation as US workers.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Microsoft השיבה שרוב הבקשות נגעו לעובדים קיימים ושעובדים בינלאומיים מקבלים שכר באותה רמה כמו עובדים אמריקאים.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article mention that Satya Nadella received a technology medal at the White House on the same day?
options: To prove Microsoft had already won its visa case
To show that Nadella controls the Department of Labor
To highlight the contrast between official praise for Microsoft's technology and sharp criticism of its hiring practices
To explain why Microsoft stopped paying foreign workers
tasks.correct_answer: To highlight the contrast between official praise for Microsoft's technology and sharp criticism of its hiring practices
tasks.explanation_hebrew: האזכור מדגיש ניגוד: הבית הלבן כיבד את מנכ״ל Microsoft על חדשנות ובאותו יום תקף בחריפות את מדיניות ההעסקה של החברה.

tasks.prompt: In this article, what is a “pathway” to permanent residence?
options: A route or process that can lead to permanent status
A temporary salary reduction
A numerical limit on yearly visas
A conference for technology executives
tasks.correct_answer: A route or process that can lead to permanent status
tasks.explanation_hebrew: pathway פירושו מסלול או תהליך; תוכנית PERM יכולה להוביל לגרין קארד ולשהייה קבועה בארה״ב.

tasks.prompt: Explain the relationship between the H1b and PERM programs as described in the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר ש־H1b מיועדת לעובדים מיומנים או מתמחים ונחשבת שלב מקדים אפשרי, ואילו PERM הוא מסלול לתושבות קבע ולעיתים לגרין קארד.
expected_points: The H1b program allows companies to employ highly skilled or specialised international workers.
The annual number of H1b visas is capped at 85,000.
H1b status can be a precursor for workers seeking the PERM process.
PERM can lead to permanent US residence and often a Green Card.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the evidence used by JD Vance and the counter-evidence offered by Microsoft.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול את ההשוואה בין כ־6,000 פיטורים ל־6,800 בקשות H1b, ואת תשובת Microsoft לגבי 80% עובדים קיימים, שכר שווה ורוב עובדים אמריקאים.
expected_points: Vance linked about 6,000 layoffs with 6,800 H1b applications during a similar period.
He argued this showed foreign workers were replacing domestic workers and undercutting wages.
Microsoft said 80% of its recent H1b filings were for people already employed by the company.
Microsoft said foreign hires receive the same compensation as US workers and that most US employees are American.

tasks.prompt: Why might the proposed removal of the 60-day grace period make sponsored workers more dependent on their employers?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שכיום לעובד שפוטר יש 60 יום לחפש פתרון, והסרת התקופה עלולה לחייב יציאה מיידית יותר מארה״ב ולהגדיל את תלותו במעסיק נותן החסות.
expected_points: A sponsored worker may have to leave the US after losing the sponsoring job.
The current 60-day period gives some time to seek another lawful option.
Removing it would reduce the time available after dismissal or layoff.
That consequence could increase the worker's dependence on the sponsoring employer.

tasks.prompt: Write a balanced policy note identifying what evidence would help assess whether skilled-worker visas replace US workers or fill genuine shortages.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע נתונים על סוג המשרות, עובדים קיימים לעומת חדשים, פיטורים וגיוסים, שכר, מחסור בכישורים וההשוואה לעובדים מקומיים, בלי לאמץ אוטומטית צד אחד.
expected_points: Separate applications for existing workers from those for new hires.
Compare layoffs and visa hiring by role, location and time rather than only total numbers.
Examine whether qualified domestic applicants were available for the specialised jobs.
Compare wages and compensation for international and US workers in equivalent roles.
